title: Three Key Decorating Tips for Renters
paragraphs: If you rent your home, you may feel that there is not much you can do to make it look nice. Many landlords do not allow tenants to paint the walls or make big changes. However, there are still some simple ways to make a rented home feel like your own. Here are three key tips.

Rugs are one of the most popular ways to decorate a rented home. They can cover floors that you do not like, and they make a room feel warmer and softer. Best of all, you can roll them up easily and take them with you when you move to a new home.

Lighting can change the mood of a room and create an instant focal point. If you are not allowed to install new ceiling lights, you can add table lamps and floor lamps to create a warmer feeling. Like rugs, lamps are easy to take with you when you leave.

Peel-and-stick wallpaper has become a popular way to add color and patterns to walls without painting. Some decorating experts suggest using it in small areas, such as behind a desk or inside a bookcase. However, not everyone agrees that it is a good idea. One property manager has warned that removable wallpaper is one of the main reasons why landlords keep money from tenants' deposits, because it can damage the paint when it is removed. The same can be true for sticky hooks and LED light strips.

For this reason, it is always a good idea to read your rental contract carefully and ask your landlord for permission before making any changes. Choosing items that you can easily take with you, such as rugs and lamps, is usually the safest option.
